anomaly_label: Jumpy heater (H702, H706, H704, H708) power

evidence.observation: H701 reads 339.062 °C while H702 reads 72.024 °C and the reboiler vessel reads 61.659 °C; the large heater-temperature discrepancy persists throughout the observations.
H701 remains at 340.000 °C versus H702 at 70.513 °C and the vessel at 61.936 °C; readings alone do not distinguish actual localized overheating from a measurement fault.
Reflux flow rises from 0.423 to 0.658 and buffer differential pressure rises from 2.004 to 3.703 mbar.
Reflux flow and buffer differential pressure partially recover to 0.501 and 2.244 mbar; system pressure is 299.184 mbar and cooling-water flow remains present at 3.643.

args.missing_evidence: H701 operating setpoint, permitted heater temperature and power history, and an independent heater-temperature check are needed to distinguish expected heater operation, overheating and sensor error. Command history would clarify the late reflux transient. No composition measurement or separation target has been supplied.
